about: Playlist Studio gallery. Each entry is loaded like a dropped .bplist. type 'url' fetches a live playlist (the host must allow CORS), type 'file' loads gallery/<file> from this repo, type 'share' opens a Playlist Studio share code, and type 'beatsaver' builds a live list from a BeatSaver search: 'query' holds the search parameters, 'pick' the notes-per-second window used to choose one Standard difficulty per map, and 'count' how many maps to take.

entries.name: First custom maps
entries.description: 20 of the best-rated curated maps on BeatSaver, each set to an easier difficulty (about 1.5 to 3.5 notes a second). A good first playlist after installing mods.
entries.author: BeatSaver, picked live

entries.name: Popular fun maps
entries.description: The highest-rated maps on BeatSaver at a medium difficulty (about 3.5 to 5.5 notes a second). Well-loved songs, not ranked-only.
entries.author: BeatSaver, picked live

entries.name: Step it up
entries.description: Highly rated curated maps at a harder difficulty (about 5 to 7 notes a second), for when the first two feel easy.
